headings: DECLARATION on the Use of AI
current_requirements.numbering: Page and line numbers required; affiliations numbered.
current_requirements.citations: Consecutive bracketed numerals in first-appearance order.
current_requirements.reference_list: Numbered with periods, first seven authors then et al. when more than seven, Index Medicus journal abbreviation, year;volume:pages/article number; omit DOI.
current_requirements.submission_files: Word .docx plus a complete PDF with end-positioned tables and figures, separate JPG figures, filenames beginning with first-author family name; no RAR archive.
current_requirements.AI: Formal heading DECLARATION on the Use of AI; tool name/version, actual uses and author accuracy verification; effective May 2026.
current_requirements.ethics: Methods must accurately report institutional ethics approval and relevant animal-care guidance; no unverified compliance statements.
current_requirements.identifiers: ORCID or Researcher ID if available; never fabricate.
current_requirements.supplementary_files: No specific file size/naming/deposit workflow found; clear separately attached inventory is appropriate.

citation_audit.source_style: Unnumbered reference list using MMR-like author-colon format with DOI; parenthesized numerical citations.
citation_audit.needed: After content decisions, renumber list and citations by first appearance; change parentheses to brackets; reformat entries; remove displayed DOI while retaining DOI in internal provenance record.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: 267-word Abstract, six keywords, 95-character short title, seven main figure items
content_compliance_checklist.action: Use Summary <=250 words; <=5 keywords; short title <=60 characters; <=6 combined main figures/tables after evidence review.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: AI statement only mentions language/readability and includes [version/model]
content_compliance_checklist.action: Replace with truthful actual assistance scope, name/version or explicit missing archived version, author verification; use exact required heading.
Retain confirmed parent sixty-animal flow and distinguish present group allocations from assay effective n; do not infer animal IDs or identities of unmatched rows.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Serum figure legend n=10 and general ELISA/absorbance/standard-curve methods conflict with prior records
content_compliance_checklist.action: Use only the selected serum dataset with its actual numeric/source evidence; prior user-confirmed serum n was eight, not ten. SOD WST-1/MDA colorimetry/ROS fluorescence are not universally ELISA. If serum evidence remains unavailable, report its status rather than reinstating unsupported statistics.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Source reinstates quantified WB proteins and P values
content_compliance_checklist.action: No full membranes or animal-level densitometry are currently available. Do not present quantitative protein upregulation or infer full n from representative cropped bands.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Title and body imply region-specific Nox protein/ROS findings and systemic oxidative-stress association with BP
content_compliance_checklist.action: Describe the actual medullary block including surrounding tissue, verified endpoints and group observations; avoid per-animal association without joint identifiers/correlation data.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Restoration reduced/reversed pathology and schematic asserts cervical afferent -> AngII/AT1R -> NOX/ROS -> sympathetic -> BP
content_compliance_checklist.action: Explicitly separate day28 model-sham observations from day56 removal group; pathway is hypothesized, not measured; remove unsupported causal edges or exclude schematic.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Limitations claim local RVLM oxidative indices not measured while Results says they were
content_compliance_checklist.action: Resolve to actual tissue data; distinguish absence of validated ROS/species/activity measures from existence of regional SOD/MDA/fluorescence values.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Methods contain placeholders for sample preparation, qPCR primers and processing, WB, statistics, address and AI
content_compliance_checklist.action: Fill from prior supplied documents only where actual experiment supports it; remove inapplicable WB quantification rather than inventing procedures.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Postoperative analgesia omission and incomplete written rationale omitted in new source
content_compliance_checklist.action: Retain actual lack of postoperative analgesia and record limitations; approval number alone does not establish analgesia exemption.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: HE described as cellular density/inflammation and restoration less pronounced
content_compliance_checklist.action: Qualitative supplied images only; unknown animal n and marker identity preclude cell-type or inflammatory conclusions and quantitative group claims.

content_compliance_checklist.issue: Funding named Anhui Province National Natural Science Foundation of China
content_compliance_checklist.action: Use verified provincial fund name and grant 1608085MH185; funder only financial support, no scientific or submission role as confirmed.

novelty_and_overlap.appropriate_increment: Regional medullary redox indices and Nox1/Nox4 mRNA observations in an existing atlantoaxial model; not a newly established model, nor proof of sympathetic/AngII/NOX causal mechanism.
novelty_and_overlap.introduction: Cite 2017 model paper as method/model precedent and 2026 AngII/AT1-R paper as related work; articulate the actual new assays without claiming first discovery unless literature verified.
novelty_and_overlap.methods_data_availability: Disclose source experiment relationship and precisely what BP data were reused. Do not assert no shared animals or all new independent animals when individual linkage cannot be reconstructed.
novelty_and_overlap.results_legends: Identify any reused BP observations as previously reported/reanalyzed, and distinguish archived rows/summaries from independent rat n. Do not count reused BP as independent replication.
novelty_and_overlap.cover_letter: Identify both related papers, state known BP sharing with 2026 report, specify which presently supported biochemical/transcript results are new, acknowledge remaining animal-linkage limits.
novelty_claims_to_remove: first novel hypertension model in this paper
demonstrated reversal or independent therapeutic effect
proved Nox upregulation mediates sympathetic hypertension
protein expression quantified without source data
novelty_and_overlap.permission: If published figures are reused, check actual license/permission and cite source; reused own data also require transparent disclosure.

no_actions: No Word changes, email submission or Git actions performed.
